# ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade (Data Source)

Get Connector Scheduled Upgrade

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve the scheduled upgrade configuration for a ZTNA Connector.
data "ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade" "example" {
  oid = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
}

output "connector_scheduled_upgrade" {
  value = {
    image_id           = data.ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade.example.image_id
    scheduled_download = data.ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade.example.scheduled_download
    scheduled_upgrade  = data.ztna_connector_scheduled_upgrade.example.scheduled_upgrade
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oid` (String) Parent connector OID.

### Read-Only

- `image_id` (String) The connector image version ID to upgrade to.
- `scheduled_download` (String) The scheduled download time in RFC3339 format (UTC).  If omitted, defaults to current UTC time.
- `scheduled_upgrade` (String) The scheduled upgrade time in RFC3339 format (UTC).  Must be after the scheduled_download time. If omitted, defaults to current UTC time.
- `tfid` (String)
